IT Support Request – Administrator Guide

Use this application to review, manage, and track IT support requests submitted by users.

Managing Requests

  1. Open the IT Support Request list.

  2. Review newly submitted requests.

  3. Verify the request details and confirm the reported issue.

  4. Update the request status as work progresses.

  5. Assign the request to the appropriate support person or team, if assignment fields are available.

  6. Add relevant work notes and update the record when necessary.

  7. Close the request after the issue has been resolved.

Important Information

  • Ensure request details are complete and accurate.

  • Keep request statuses up to date.

  • Follow up on pending requests.

  • Maintain clear documentation of actions taken.

  • Ensure users can access only the records and information permitted by their roles.

Related information

  • Managing IT Support Requests

  • Updating Request Status

  • Reviewing Submitted Requests

  • IT Support Request Administration Guidelines

Note: Please review and update IT Support Requests regularly to ensure proper tracking and timely resolution.
